name: Platinum
source:
The summer of his third year, our protagonist transfers across a mountain range from his snowy home town to a school in a neighboring prefecture. Because of this he his separated from his girlfriend Shirasaka Yukine, who he had just started dating.  They swore to each other, “Even if we’re apart we’ll be fine. In half a year we’ll both get into the same university.”

However, his new town comes with a new life, and new encounters. And naturally, new love starts to bloom. The reality of their long-distance relationship puts a strain on things between him and Yukine. Little misunderstandings and the pain of being apart starts many fights between them. A new romance soothes the pain and loneliness.

Will he continue his relationship with his lover, or will he chose a new romance with someone closer to him? Yukine suggests that the unsure protagonist meets with her one more time to talk things over.

In order to express his true feelings, the protagonist must cross mountain peaks back to his home town. But a rare blizzard cuts off his route home. Will things end without him ever seeing her again? Should he leave the mountain and retreat into a new romance? In the driving snow, the protagonist sets out for the mountain pass. 

[Translation of synopsis from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8782]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
高中三年级的夏天，主人公穿越山脉，从积雪覆盖的故乡转学到邻县的学校。因此，他不得不与刚开始交往的女友白坂雪音分开。两人彼此约定：「即使分开也没关系。半年后，我们都会考进同一所大学。」

然而，新城镇带来了新生活、新相遇，自然也孕育出新的恋情。远距离恋爱给他和雪音的关系带来重压；小小的误会与分离的痛苦，令两人频频争吵。一段新的恋情抚慰了他的痛苦与孤独。

他会继续与恋人交往，还是选择身边的新恋情？面对犹豫不决的主人公，雪音提议两人再见一次面，彻底谈一谈。

为了表达真实心意，主人公必须翻越山峰回到故乡。但一场罕见的暴风雪截断了归路。他会在再也见不到雪音的情况下迎来结局吗？还是该离开山中，退回新的恋情？在狂风大雪中，主人公向山口出发。

[简介译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=8782]Getchu.com[/url]]
